references.text: Luke 21:12 also describes difficult times and persecutions that can cause love to grow cold for some.
2 Timothy 3:1-5 warns of difficult times in the last days, where people will be self-centered and without love, reflecting the warning in Matthew 24:12.
Revelation 2:4 speaks of having left one's first love, which can be seen as a result of increasing wickedness.
